preserve.evidence: Both: window x88-283, wall 318-530, window 565-735, wall 770-1000, window 1035-1192 (image 2: windows 118-268, 587-720, 1050-1170) - same order.

On 1 each window is a dark board panel filling the field side to side (mid: 563-735 in field 562-738, ~98%), no plaster beside it; on 2 a small two-leaf shutter in the upper middle (mid: 598-705 of 562-747, ~58%; ~72% with painted frame) with plaster on both sides and below.
Painted posts ~28-30 px on 1 and ~20-25 px on 2 vs volumetric corner post ~52-55 px (x1189-1241) and belt beam ~79-80 px (y468-547) on both; 1 is visibly heavier but still about half the corner post.

On 1 the infill is a fine dark speckle/lichen pattern with vertical drip streaks under every rail; on 2 matte plaster with large soft patches (fine-scale energy 6.6-7.0 vs 5.2-5.9, large-patch std 2.9-3.8 vs 7.0-8.6).
Plaster luma ~54-55 on 1 and ~52 on 2 vs timber 14-18 on both; dark wood on light infill equally clear.
Both gables: posts at x~300/525/750/975, middle rail y~245-275, V/diagonal braces in upper and lower corners of every field; only brace shape differs (see findings).
Frame ends at y=720 inside the upper floor; no stone base is in either image.

findings.text: Preserve item 2: on 1 the windows are wide board panels that fill the whole field between posts, with no plaster on the sides; on 2 they are small shutters with plaster around them.
findings.measure: Mid window 563-735 px in field 562-738 (~98%) on 1 vs shutter 598-705 in field 562-747 (~58%) on 2; left and right windows give the same result.

findings.text: Rejected default 3 (window the full width of the field between beams) is present on 1.
findings.measure: Window/field width ratio ~0.98-1.0 on all three windows of 1.

findings.text: Preserve item 4: on 1 the infill reads as speckled lichen with drip streaks, not as matte lime plaster with soft patches; visible at game distance across the whole facade.
Rejected default 6 (plaster with a crackle/lichen pattern) is present on 1: dark spots and vertical drips in every field.
findings.measure: Same as above; 3x crop gable_center_1 shows dense dark spots and drips.

findings.text: The lower braces of the gable fields are curved (shield-shaped fields) on 1 and straight (octagonal fields) on 2.
findings.measure: 3x crop [280,330,560,480]: the brace edge is an arc on 1 and a straight line on 2.

findings.text: Axis-aligned rectangular light/dark blocks in the plaster at the bottom of the middle gable field: block artifact of the texture.
findings.measure: 5x autocontrast crop [360,340,500,470] and gable_center_2: rectilinear blocks ~5-10 px.

findings.text: The same plaster patch pattern repeats in adjacent fields (one module per field), most visible as the same light lower area in gable fields.
findings.measure: Raw NCC between gable fields 0.76/0.67 and wall fields 0.74 on 2; 0.63/0.43 and 0.39 on 1 (high-pass ~0.6 on both).

findings.text: The background tower also differs: a darker shingled roof and dark windows on 2, a lighter smooth roof and light panels on 1. Outside the object under review.
findings.measure: Visual comparison of the same region.

criteria.silhouette: same - geometry and camera are identical; frame and post layout match
criteria.main_feature: 2 - small shutter with frame and plaster around it; on 1 the window is a board panel the width of the field
criteria.crookedness_wear: 2 - sagging sill and slightly uneven painted posts, worn barge boards; 1 has curved braces but flat, even panels
criteria.tone_light: same - plaster luma 52-55, timber 14-18 on both, nearly the same warmth
criteria.material: 2 - matte plaster with soft patches; 1 is speckle/lichen with drips
criteria.coherence: 2 - the windows sit in the timber frame as part of the wall; on 1 the panels and lichen read as texture stuck onto the fields

unverified: 7 - stone base below the upper floor is not in the frame
reasons: Preserve 2 = no: on image 1 the windows fill the field, on 2 they are small with plaster around
Preserve 4 = no: lichen speckle with drips on image 1
